summary: Connect anatomical, diffusion, hemodynamic and molecular images without treating them as interchangeable views.
outcomes: Explain what structural MRI, diffusion MRI and PET contrasts represent.
Identify registration, resolution and inference limits in a multimodal analysis.
sequence: Compare images of the same region with different contrasts
Introduce structural contrast and voxel geometry
Explain diffusion measurements and tractography ambiguity
Locate PET and molecular imaging in the modality map
Separate structural, functional and effective connectivity

visual.question: Does a visible tract establish a direct functional connection?
visual.interaction: Toggle synthetic crossing fibers, voxel resolution and registration error.

practice.task: Critique a multimodal connectivity claim using a supplied image-and-method packet.
practice.success: Names each measured quantity and at least two ambiguity sources.
